text: Cam Newton draws first blood. Panthers 7–0.
Cincinnati hits right back. 7–7.
Then Gio Bernard breaks free. 89 yards. Bengals 14–7.
A field goal each. Cincinnati carries a 17–10 lead into halftime.
Third quarter. Dalton throws it straight to the enemy.
Carolina makes him pay at once. 17–17.
Cam Newton bulldozes into the end zone. Panthers 24–17.
And Dalton does it again. Another interception. The Bengals are sinking.
Fourth quarter. Down and desperate, Dalton goes deep to Sanu. 24–24. Now it's war.
Newton strikes back. Olsen in the end zone. Panthers 31–24.
Pacman Jones takes the kickoff. And runs. And runs...
...97 yards, and the Bengals punch it in. 31–31. Back from the dead.
Newton forces it deep. Intercepted. Now Carolina is the one dying.
Nugent kicks Cincinnati ahead, 34–31. Two minutes left. Surely that's the end.
Final seconds. Newton has dragged Carolina into range. Gano, 44 yards...
Good. 34–34. Overtime.
Overtime. Nugent puts Cincinnati up 37–34. But Carolina gets one last chance.
Gano answers. 37–37. Neither team will stay buried.
Two seconds left. Nugent, 36 yards, to end it all...
Wide right. Seventy-five minutes of war, and nobody survives.
